purpose.en: Establish the mission, isolate Zao, and let her warning leave before the crew understands its destination.
Carry suspicion across the long approach until independent facts and delayed light converge.
Turn evidence into physical action, delay the bomb, and preserve an uncertain first contact.

summary.en: An argument is misread while an improvised crew races to leave.
The crew tests the meaning of contact and experiences the first gravity loss.
Zao turns a mass discrepancy into the discovery of a timed weapon.
Harlan severs Zao from the ship while she searches for one surviving warning path.
Zao sends an unseen warning; Harlan kills her and blocks an abort.
Sorell arrives too late and Harlan turns her rescue attempt into suspicion.
Elin separates false explanations until the lost transmission returns.
Zao’s delayed message supplies the warning and evidence needed to act.
Harlan escapes custody and the fourth gravity loss changes the pursuit.
The crew delays the bomb and answers the Velari without claiming certainty.
The surviving crew repairs the ship and sends Zao’s achievement home.
The title holds over delayed Earth light reaching Proxima.

We don’t begin by punishing them for it. voss: First we arrive. Philosophy after turnover.

Her dosimeter begins a sparse neutron tick.

Repeat. rao: Wireless just vanished across her deck. voss: Elin, find the break. Okoye, bridge security.

summary.en: At the tray below the hatch, Harlan disconnects the wired communications and camera trunks without speaking, then launches ballistically down the service shaft. sorell: I can reach her faster than I can repair a repeater. voss: Find Harlan. summary.en: Zao finishes the sentence into dead air, then tests every channel while the vault timer continues. zao: —and Harlan knows. Bridge? zao: Radio. Hardline. Emergency. All three. That’s deliberate. The local optical array still answers. She checks obvious destinations against geometry and delay. zao: Proxima’s behind Jupiter. Earth gets it, answers too late. The throat won’t listen. zao: And I can’t address the Velari without Sorell. Not back. Not through. Not to them. The crossing clock aligns with ordinary light-time. Zao stops talking and plots a moving intercept. Only 23 H 15 MIN is legible; destination and trajectory remain hidden. zao: There you are.

summary.en: Zao records into volatile memory. We see her speak but hear only breath, controls, and the approaching vibration of the service hatch. The contents remain withheld. The recording is deliberately inaudible here so the destination and warning return together later. She signs the packet, sets divergence and a narrow uncertainty sweep, and transmits. The interface shows TRANSMITTED, never the aim point. A restrained confirmation tone, followed by the hard mechanical release of the hatch.

summary.en: Harlan enters. Zao closes the pointing solution before he can read it. He sees only that a transmission left. harlan: Who did you send that to? Zao says nothing. A distant sound tells him Sorell is approaching. He chooses assumption over reconstruction. harlan: Not Proxima. Not the throat. You don’t speak Velari. harlan: Earth, then. They may believe you. Their answer still can’t reach us before contact. harlan: You should never have had to find it. He closes in. Cut to black before impact. One dry bodily impact in sustained black; Zao’s breath stops.

summary.en: Harlan leaves Zao outside the inner vault, closes and rekeys it with his wrist device, then disconnects bridge flight commands and the remote cutoff at the adjacent local console. The throat’s opening builds as a low structural chorus. voss: Aperture stable. Hold the line. rao: We’re through. The far mouth closes behind the Ardor. The bridge celebrates while Zao drifts unseen below.

summary.en: Sorell reaches the outer bay, catches Zao’s drifting body, checks airway and pulse, and tries to stop blood that no longer circulates. sorell: Zao? Zao, look at me. Come on. sorell: Bridge, Zao is down. Medical emergency. Does anyone copy? Above, Harlan reconnects the trunks, disables the jammer, and emerges into the vestibule. harlan: Found the break. Both trunks were out at the service tray. voss: Did Sorell find you? harlan: I never saw her. The camera feed returns on Sorell holding the bloodied body. voss: Okoye, with Harlan. Go.

purpose.en: Dramatize suspicion travels through observable choice, pressure, and consequence.

summary.en: harlan: How could you? Why? sorell: I found her like this. I tried to help her. okoye: Hands where I can see them. Both of you. With no brig, Sorell is held under watch on the bridge as thrust returns for the long station leg. harlan: She wanted the contact delayed. You heard her. rao: I heard her disagree with you. That isn’t the same thing. voss: Nobody closes this case. Elin: mass and records. Okoye: preserve everything.

purpose.en: Dramatize one theory, two failures through observable choice, pressure, and consequence.

summary.en: harlan: A deuterium-rich mix explains the fuel and the neutrons. It also explains a delay she kept asking for. voss: Elin? rao: It is a hypothesis. Hours compress through repeated audits, sample checks, and engine history. rao: Mixture normal. No leak. No efficiency loss. rao: The engine burned extra fuel because the ship was heavier. The neutrons came from somewhere else. voss: So his explanation explains neither. rao: Correct.

summary.en: Midway to the station, thrust cuts for the third time. The Ardor turns to begin braking; Elin and Okoye float beside the sealed vault. Engine tone drains away. The diagnostic unit’s magnetic feet clamp to the workbench. okoye: Captain’s authority is rejected. Local lock only. harlan: Sorell had the blackout. She could have rekeyed it then. rao: Could have is not did. The data proves hidden mass and a compact neutron source, not yet a bomb. Elin leaves a time-reference diagnostic on the bench and returns to the optical traces. rao: Leave this logging. I want the burst.

summary.en: Only firing angles and ship attitude survive from Zao’s burst. Its vector points at no planet, station, or beacon. harlan: She tried to finish the warning to Earth. Under pressure, she missed. rao: Zao didn’t miss like that. voss: Then what did she hit? rao: Nothing fixed. Give me trajectories. Alone for a moment, Harlan watches the unrecoverable burst record. harlan: Now they’ll never know who saved them. Thirteen minutes before contact, an optical signal appears on the same corridor. rao: Captain. It didn’t miss. It found us.

purpose.en: Dramatize zao’s message arrives through observable choice, pressure, and consequence.

summary.en: rao: Zao’s packet format. Personal signature. Sent before the crossing. voss: Play it. Flashback restores Zao’s hidden pointing solution: ordinary light aimed at the future Ardor, twenty-three light-hours beyond the throat. zao: If this reaches you, I found a Proxima geophysical impulse package in the shielded vault: one point three tonnes, multi-megaton, armed for the contact coordinates and time. The neutron signature is real. The controller is protected; don’t cut power or damage it. zao: I couldn’t reach Proxima through Jupiter. Earth could hear me, but no answer could catch you. The pilot throat won’t receive us, and I had no confirmed Velari target. So I aimed at where the Ardor would be after the jump. zao: The vault’s local. Use its scientific service timing input if you can. Just in case: goodbye. Harlan’s at the door. voss: Abort approach. Hold Harlan. okoye: Commander, stay where you are.

purpose.en: Dramatize not the voice through observable choice, pressure, and consequence.

summary.en: harlan: A voice and a face can be built from ship archives. You know that. rao: I’m not using the voice. rao: Her personal signature and timestamp are valid. The mass, neutrons, vector, lock, your missing location, and that accusation all agree with her. harlan: Agree is not prove. rao: No. It is enough to isolate you. It is enough to release her. Voss looks from Harlan to Sorell and sees how much of his case came from his first mistake.

summary.en: voss: Harlan’s network authority is revoked. Sorell, you are released. I need the greeting ready. sorell: You’ll have it. The bridge path is physically open. voss: Where can we break it? rao: Aft local console. Three minutes if the elevator is clear. voss: Go. Sorell, stay on approach. Okoye, secure him and take that wrist device.

He’s in the bay with her. voss: Keep moving. No more hatches.

We can talk about sorry later. voss: One greeting. Nothing else. Send.

text.en: Harlan offers no correction. Sorell looks at Voss, surprised that he heard reluctance.
After the others disperse, Zao catches Voss alone beside the delayed feed.

en.spokenText: That wasn’t hope.
en.delivery: low and exact; no accusation yet

intention.en: reassure her and close the subject

en.spokenText: You find faults for a living. That doesn’t make everyone a fault.
en.delivery: fond dismissal; already turning back to work

intention.en: leave a specific concern without inventing proof

en.spokenText: I’m not talking about everyone.
en.delivery: held back; she lets the warning stand

text.en: The exact opening schedule has arrived too late for an Earth delegation. Cargo moves through Proxima’s axial dock at emergency tempo.

en.spokenText: Commander, hazardous stores are yours. Nothing boards without your mark.
Understood. I’ll close the vault myself.
Manifest balances. We’re ready.

intention.en: verify independently rather than distrust Elin

en.spokenText: From this direction. Give me one pass from the other.

intention.en: honor her habit without losing the window

en.spokenText: One minute, Zao. Then I need my ship.
You’ll have her.

text.en: Under steady thrust, the small crew shares a meal from anchored trays. The Ardor’s long silhouette rotates on a systems display.

intention.en: release tension through the ship’s grand name

en.spokenText: Celestial Ardor. Sounds like a perfume with engine trouble.

intention.en: join the joke and pivot toward communication

en.spokenText: Better than telling the Velari we arrived in the Flying Radiator.

intention.en: turn humor into his real fear

en.spokenText: And what if we’re the ones being read wrong?

intention.en: state her method without guaranteeing trust

en.spokenText: Then we correct the reading. We don’t begin by punishing them for it.

intention.en: return the crew to the flight clock

en.spokenText: First we arrive. Philosophy after turnover.

text.en: At Jupiter periapsis, thrust cuts. Loose straps rise. The central stair becomes a helix without up or down as the ship turns end for end.

description.en: Engine vibration falls away; restraints click and a loose spoon taps slowly against its tether.

intention.en: mark the physical change without explaining it

en.spokenText: There goes the floor.

intention.en: steady the others through the maneuver

en.spokenText: Keep a hand on something you like.

text.en: Thrust returns in the opposite direction. Weight settles back as the Ardor begins braking toward the mouth.
Near the mouth, thrust cuts again for the precision crossing. Zao braces at an engineering console while the rest of the ship floats.

intention.en: eliminate engine failure and identify hidden mass

en.spokenText: Burn’s clean. Feed is clean. So what were we carrying?

text.en: She recomputes the profile. A small propellant excess repeats exactly across the long leg.

en.spokenText: One point three tonnes. Not noise.

description.en: Her dosimeter begins a sparse neutron tick.

text.en: The neutron count strengthens toward the shielded vault. Harlan emerges from its inner bay and meets Zao in the passage.

en.spokenText: Engineer. Your readings brought you aft as well?
en.delivery: pleasant; assessing how much she knows

en.spokenText: They brought me to the door you just left.

intention.en: explain his access and the imperfect closure

en.spokenText: Scheduled inspection. The latch is temperamental in free-fall.
I’ll take it from here.

text.en: Harlan leaves. He has touched no flight control and given her nothing visible to accuse.
Inside the incompletely secured vault, Zao follows markings and the neutron peak to a Proxima geophysical impulse package. The encounter coordinates and time sit on its armed controller.

en.spokenText: Geophysical impulse package… one point three tonnes.
en.delivery: barely audible, reading only what she must confirm

en.spokenText: Multi-megaton. Contact coordinates. Contact time.
en.delivery: each fragment tighter than the last

text.en: She looks at the ordinary communications clock. No round trip can beat the timer.

en.spokenText: No. No one sent this by mistake.

text.en: Harlan rises from the service hatch behind the command vestibule. The bridge crew faces forward as Zao’s channel opens.

intention.en: make Voss act before naming an unproven culprit

en.spokenText: Bridge, Zao. I have found a grave attempt to sabotage the mission—

text.en: Only when the word sabotage lands does Harlan touch his wrist. The channel dies. He withdraws before anyone turns.

en.spokenText: Zao? Repeat.

intention.en: identify the scope of the outage

en.spokenText: Wireless just vanished across her deck.
Elin, find the break. Okoye, bridge security.

text.en: At the tray below the hatch, Harlan disconnects the wired communications and camera trunks without speaking, then launches ballistically down the service shaft.

intention.en: offer the useful action her specialty allows

en.spokenText: I can reach her faster than I can repair a repeater.
Find Harlan. Do not go in alone.
en.delivery: a pause before the second sentence; caution sharpening

intention.en: obey the escort order before proceeding

en.spokenText: Harlan, answer. Where are you?

text.en: No answer. She moves hand over hand down the slower helical stair while Harlan crosses decks in a straight free-flight line.
Zao finishes the sentence into dead air, then tests every channel while the vault timer continues.

intention.en: complete her thought and seek confirmation

en.spokenText: —and Harlan knows. Bridge?
en.delivery: the accusation escapes before she realizes nobody hears it

en.spokenText: Radio. Hardline. Emergency. All three. That’s deliberate.

text.en: The local optical array still answers. She checks obvious destinations against geometry and delay.

en.spokenText: Proxima’s behind Jupiter. Earth gets it, answers too late. The throat won’t listen.
en.delivery: thinking with her hands; each rejected path changes the plot

en.spokenText: And I can’t address the Velari without Sorell. Not back. Not through. Not to them.

text.en: The crossing clock aligns with ordinary light-time. Zao stops talking and plots a moving intercept. Only 23 H 15 MIN is legible; destination and trajectory remain hidden.

en.spokenText: There you are.

text.en: Zao records into volatile memory. We see her speak but hear only breath, controls, and the approaching vibration of the service hatch. The contents remain withheld.

purpose.en: The recording is deliberately inaudible here so the destination and warning return together later.

text.en: She signs the packet, sets divergence and a narrow uncertainty sweep, and transmits. The interface shows TRANSMITTED, never the aim point.

description.en: A restrained confirmation tone, followed by the hard mechanical release of the hatch.

text.en: Harlan enters. Zao closes the pointing solution before he can read it. He sees only that a transmission left.

intention.en: learn whether the mission can still be stopped

en.spokenText: Who did you send that to?
en.delivery: quiet, controlled; the threat is in the lack of haste

text.en: Zao says nothing. A distant sound tells him Sorell is approaching. He chooses assumption over reconstruction.

en.spokenText: Not Proxima. Not the throat. You don’t speak Velari.
en.delivery: thinking aloud because time is closing

en.spokenText: Earth, then. They may believe you. Their answer still can’t reach us before contact.

intention.en: acknowledge her humanity before killing her

en.spokenText: You should never have had to find it.
en.delivery: a genuine regret that does not change his choice

text.en: He closes in. Cut to black before impact.

description.en: One dry bodily impact in sustained black; Zao’s breath stops.

text.en: Harlan leaves Zao outside the inner vault, closes and rekeys it with his wrist device, then disconnects bridge flight commands and the remote cutoff at the adjacent local console. He does this only now because her warning makes an abort foreseeable.
He leaves the stored automatic plan, telemetry, and scheduled cutoff untouched, then climbs toward the communications tray.

description.en: The throat’s opening builds as a low structural chorus.

en.spokenText: Aperture stable. Hold the line.
We’re through.

text.en: The far mouth closes behind the Ardor. The bridge celebrates while Zao drifts unseen below.
Sorell reaches the outer bay, catches Zao’s drifting body, checks airway and pulse, and tries to stop blood that no longer circulates.

en.spokenText: Zao? Zao, look at me. Come on.
en.delivery: breathless; denial giving way to clinical action

en.spokenText: Bridge, Zao is down. Medical emergency. Does anyone copy?

text.en: Above, Harlan reconnects the trunks, disables the jammer, and emerges into the vestibule.

intention.en: establish a repair and an alibi

en.spokenText: Found the break. Both trunks were out at the service tray.
Did Sorell find you?
I never saw her.

text.en: The camera feed returns on Sorell holding the bloodied body.

intention.en: send security and the apparent witness

en.spokenText: Okoye, with Harlan. Go.

intention.en: fix the bridge’s first interpretation on Sorell

en.spokenText: How could you? Why?
en.delivery: instant accusation; grief performed too quickly

en.spokenText: I found her like this. I tried to help her.

intention.en: secure the scene without deciding guilt

en.spokenText: Hands where I can see them. Both of you.

text.en: With no brig, Sorell is held under watch on the bridge as thrust returns for the long station leg.

intention.en: turn Voss’s earlier misreading into motive

en.spokenText: She wanted the contact delayed. You heard her.
en.delivery: softly supplying Voss the pattern he expects

intention.en: resist an accusation that arrived too neatly

en.spokenText: I heard her disagree with you. That isn’t the same thing.
en.delivery: quiet; eyes on Sorell rather than Harlan

en.spokenText: Nobody closes this case. Elin: mass and records. Okoye: preserve everything.

intention.en: join the clues into a case against Sorell

en.spokenText: A deuterium-rich mix explains the fuel and the neutrons. It also explains a delay she kept asking for.
en.delivery: reasonable, helpful, never pushing too visibly

en.spokenText: Elin?
It is a hypothesis.

text.en: Hours compress through repeated audits, sample checks, and engine history.

en.spokenText: Mixture normal. No leak. No efficiency loss.

intention.en: replace one false cause with two real problems

en.spokenText: The engine burned extra fuel because the ship was heavier. The neutrons came from somewhere else.
en.delivery: decisive, each clause separating a clue

intention.en: recognize the case against Sorell weakening

en.spokenText: So his explanation explains neither.
Correct.

text.en: Midway to the station, thrust cuts for the third time. The Ardor turns to begin braking; Elin and Okoye float beside the sealed vault.

description.en: Engine tone drains away. The diagnostic unit’s magnetic feet clamp to the workbench.

en.spokenText: Captain’s authority is rejected. Local lock only.

intention.en: preserve suspicion without exposing his knowledge

en.spokenText: Sorell had the blackout. She could have rekeyed it then.
Could have is not did.

text.en: The data proves hidden mass and a compact neutron source, not yet a bomb. Elin leaves a time-reference diagnostic on the bench and returns to the optical traces.

en.spokenText: Leave this logging. I want the burst.

text.en: Only firing angles and ship attitude survive from Zao’s burst. Its vector points at no planet, station, or beacon.

intention.en: bury the burst as a failed accusation

en.spokenText: She tried to finish the warning to Earth. Under pressure, she missed.

intention.en: keep the vector alive as evidence

en.spokenText: Zao didn’t miss like that.
Then what did she hit?
Nothing fixed. Give me trajectories.
en.delivery: fast; the problem has changed shape

text.en: Alone for a moment, Harlan watches the unrecoverable burst record.

intention.en: reveal his need for eventual vindication

en.spokenText: Now they’ll never know who saved them.

text.en: Thirteen minutes before contact, an optical signal appears on the same corridor.

en.spokenText: Captain. It didn’t miss. It found us.
en.delivery: a stunned breath becoming command urgency

en.spokenText: Zao’s packet format. Personal signature. Sent before the crossing.
Play it.

text.en: Flashback restores Zao’s hidden pointing solution: ordinary light aimed at the future Ardor, twenty-three light-hours beyond the throat.

intention.en: identify the weapon and prevent a fatal response

en.spokenText: If this reaches you, I found a Proxima geophysical impulse package in the shielded vault: one point three tonnes, multi-megaton, armed for the contact coordinates and time. The neutron signature is real. The controller is protected; don’t cut power or damage it.
en.delivery: compressed urgency, exact enough to act on; fear held at the edges

intention.en: reveal why the complex intercept was the only useful warning

en.spokenText: I couldn’t reach Proxima through Jupiter. Earth could hear me, but no answer could catch you. The pilot throat won’t receive us, and I had no confirmed Velari target. So I aimed at where the Ardor would be after the jump.
en.delivery: thinking made concise after the calculation is solved

intention.en: supply a safe lead, identify immediate danger, and say farewell

en.spokenText: The vault’s local. Use its scientific service timing input if you can. Just in case: goodbye. Harlan’s at the door.
en.delivery: the technical instruction stays steady; the farewell softens by one degree

intention.en: stop the encounter and secure the named suspect

en.spokenText: Abort approach. Hold Harlan.
en.delivery: shock becomes command in one breath

en.spokenText: Commander, stay where you are.
A voice and a face can be built from ship archives. You know that.
I’m not using the voice.
Her personal signature and timestamp are valid. The mass, neutrons, vector, lock, your missing location, and that accusation all agree with her.
Agree is not prove.
No. It is enough to isolate you. It is enough to release her.

text.en: Voss looks from Harlan to Sorell and sees how much of his case came from his first mistake.

intention.en: restore the people and roles needed to survive

en.spokenText: Harlan’s network authority is revoked. Sorell, you are released. I need the greeting ready.
en.delivery: formal, owning the reversal without delay

intention.en: return to work before processing the injustice

en.spokenText: You’ll have it.

text.en: For eight minutes, normal aborts and the remote cutoff reach the system but not the autonomous plan.

intention.en: locate the failure beyond software authority

en.spokenText: Commands arrive. The plan never sees them. The bridge path is physically open.
Where can we break it?
Aft local console. Three minutes if the elevator is clear.
Go. Sorell, stay on approach. Okoye, secure him and take that wrist device.

text.en: Harlan extends the wrist device. Okoye reaches without relaxing her stance.

en.spokenText: You served long enough to know caution isn’t treason.
en.delivery: soft appeal, strategically personal but not based on invented shared history

en.spokenText: Give me the device.

text.en: A revocation alert flashes. Okoye glances at it; Harlan drives her into the console, dives into the service shaft, and locks the hatch locally.

en.spokenText: Harlan!
en.delivery: sharp pain turned immediately into pursuit

intention.en: give Elin the threat she cannot see

en.spokenText: Elin, he’s coming aft.

intention.en: state his immediate goal, not explain the plot

en.spokenText: She cannot touch that controller.
en.delivery: to himself in motion; conviction stripped bare

text.en: Elin’s elevator reaches the local console first. Harlan descends the segmented ladder, locking each access behind him. Voss and Okoye lose time at two hatches on the helical stair.

en.spokenText: Local command—come on.
en.delivery: breathless, hands moving faster than speech

description.en: A service hatch slams open behind her.

intention.en: stop her without damaging the console

en.spokenText: Step away, Elin.
One minute. He’s in the bay with her.
Keep moving. No more hatches.

text.en: Harlan pins Elin beside the vault. Fifteen metres above, Voss and Okoye reach the aligned central opening. The intact plan completes braking; thrust cuts for the fourth time.

description.en: The engine falls silent. Bodies and loose tools leave the deck at once.

text.en: The stairs cease to constrain them. Okoye launches through the opening; Voss follows. They redirect Harlan’s momentum and tether him to a rail.

intention.en: confirm control and the needed device

en.spokenText: Secured. Wrist recovered.

intention.en: state the moral fear behind his violence

en.spokenText: You don’t know what they are. You don’t get to answer for Earth.

intention.en: reveal deterrence as his intended outcome

en.spokenText: I needed time. One sign we bite, and they might wait.
en.delivery: rushing because nobody is listening anymore

intention.en: return attention to the live weapon

en.spokenText: Not now. Elin, open it.
en.delivery: refuses debate without dismissing the clock

text.en: Elin opens the vault with Harlan’s wrist. Local indicators confirm Zao’s warning: power loss or controller damage could trigger the package.

en.spokenText: No power cut. No damage. She was right.
en.delivery: fast, hands hovering clear of the controller

text.en: She sees the scientific service timing input and the diagnostic unit she planted hours earlier.

en.spokenText: External reference. That I can move.

text.en: She connects it. The display counts 4—3—2—1, then jumps upward as the ship clock crosses the original deadline.

en.spokenText: Status?
It isn’t disarmed. It just isn’t going off here.
en.delivery: controlled relief with a warning inside it

en.spokenText: Keep it watched. No thrust.

text.en: Sorell finishes translating the primer’s simultaneous geometry into branching hull lights. Elin remains on the bomb feed; Okoye guards Harlan.

intention.en: frame the greeting as a test, not proof of mastery

en.spokenText: They wrote the primer. This is the first time they’ll hear us read it back.

intention.en: own the chain of errors without demanding forgiveness

en.spokenText: Lian… I mistook caution for refusal. I sent you alone, then decided too quickly what that meant. I’m sorry.

intention.en: keep the apology from stealing the remaining moment

en.spokenText: Be right now. We can talk about sorry later.
One greeting. Nothing else. Send.

text.en: Structured light branches across the Ardor’s hull. The 4–5 km Velari station remains dark through a deliberate silence.

purpose.en: The pause lets the human greeting exist without reassurance.

text.en: The station answers with an immense luminous grammar. Sorell’s parser catches only fragments.

intention.en: extract only what the parser supports

en.spokenText: Approach. Permission… meeting.

text.en: A transparent environmental sphere separates from the station and approaches without visible exhaust.

en.spokenText: They’re sending someone.

text.en: Sorell exits alone on a tether, her suit camera feeding Voss’s bridge view. The sphere waits between ship and station.

intention.en: offer retreat without undermining the meeting

en.spokenText: Tether good. You can still come back.
en.delivery: protective, leaving the choice with her

en.spokenText: That is what makes going mean something.

text.en: Inside the sphere, a full-size Velari orients its elongated mantle toward her. Its luminous branches gather, hold attention, then extend the human greeting in living light.

purpose.en: No human translates the final pattern yet; accommodation is visible before meaning is certain.

text.en: Before the return window, flight commands still need repair and the armed package remains under constant watch.

en.spokenText: Bridge path is repairable. The bomb still gets a person beside it.
Harlan is secure. I’ll take first watch aft.
Rotate every twenty minutes. Nobody works alone.

text.en: Voss uses the restored optical array to send Earth an independent record: discovery, murder, warning, intervention, and contact. He attaches Zao’s signed message and personnel record.

intention.en: credit Zao in the official record

en.spokenText: Proxima Control, this is Celestial Ardor. Full record follows. Chief Engineer Zao found the weapon, warned us, and preserved first contact.
en.delivery: formal report fraying only on her name

text.en: TRANSMITTED. Zao’s personnel photograph remains on the display.

intention.en: recognize the victory she could not witness

en.spokenText: You made it in time.
en.delivery: private, almost a whisper after the official cadence

text.en: The new light departs into the same silence she trusted.
